fact: IPAR says it took part in the ministry's 21-22 June 2023 Dakar workshops on Senegal's national AI strategy, in two working groups, and helped draft the strategy's summary document.
IPAR says its DUA project produced a policy paper proposing AI regulation and a mapping report on AI governance.
IDRC funds the Dakar-based AI Living Lab, which does scientific work on responsible AI, with Universite numerique Cheikh Hamidou Kane as the channel.
IDRC reports a grant from 2024-09-01 supporting the Dakar-based AI Living Lab, which carries out scientific work on responsible AI focused on sustainable development goals.
